prompt:
Create one original English learning poem card, portrait, watercolor and colored pencil on warm cream paper, cheerful pastel palette, polished children's picture-book illustration consistent with a gentle educational series. Upper 52% scene: A child putting on winter clothes with jacket, coat, hat, socks and boots by the door. Lower 48% cream reading area with large exceptionally clear dark navy serif typography. Exact title: "Winter Clothes". Render these EXACT SIX LINES of the poem, verbatim, all fully visible with generous margins:
Winter morning, cold and gray.
Wear the jacket, coat today.
Shirt and pants, one sock, one shoe.
Hat and belt, one cap for you.
Button the clothes and keep the clothes dry.
Family love under the winter sky.
Do not add any other text. Original generic characters only, no brands, existing characters, recognizable artwork, or imitation of named artists. Readable text is crucial.
